column1: # This format accepts ANY CSV or TSV file that contains at least one column
# whose name maps to 'domain' (see synonyms below).
# Lines beginning with '#' are ignored by the parser.
# Supported delimiters: comma (,)  tab (\t)  semicolon (;)  pipe (|)
# Column          Accepted header names (any one is recognised)
# timestamp     : timestamp, ts, time, date, datetime, date_time,
# domain        : domain, query, fqdn, qname, query_name, hostname, host,
# query_type    : query_type, type, qtype, record_type, dns_type,
# query_length  : query_length, length, len, qlen, payload_len, size,
# Missing columns are computed (query_length = len(domain)) or defaulted to 0.
# CamelCase / PascalCase / dot-separated column names are normalised to
# snake_case before synonym lookup (e.g. DnsQueryName → dns_query_name).
